notes.title: Update 1.0.4 fixed bug achievement "What the heck"
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We just updated the game to the new version to fix bugs that the "What the heck" achievement did not pop.
Now you can please any level have the trap and the last move on it to achieve.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 boss bug fix, decrease wait time
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we just updated the game to 1.0.3 with several changes:
- We decrease the wait time after losing a level to save your time.
- Fixed bug that the game will be stuck if you can defeat the boss while remaining more than 0 moves.
We also working on a new game of Tower of Waifus series, more information will be announced in the future, follow us here for lasted info:

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 unlimited moves and key shortcut
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we just updated the game to 1.0.2 with following changes:
- Added an option to turn on unlimited moves while playing a level. The limited moves is on by default, to turn it off, please go to the option screen and change the setting.
- Improve enemy die animation for better feeling
- We have included the shortcut key to easier play the level without a mouse but have no explanation about that so now we added a shortcut key info in the button on the left side bar.
Now you can press Escape to turn back the floor screen, press R to replay level, press H to open hint, press T to skip the level and press Q to open help dialogue.

Hope you all like the new update.
Some users report an issue in the boss level, you can be stuck if you can defeat him before running out of moves. We are fixing and will update in the next version.

Regards,
Galart

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - minor bug fixes
notes.content:
